mapping_notes: D17 FAS nuclear-force country-year facts provide capability context; absence of a row is not evidence of responsible ruler conduct.
D13-D14 UCDP conflict and SIPRI military-expenditure facts provide country-year exposure/context, not automatic ruler attribution.
D12 CIRIGHTS, PTS, UCDP, and V-Dem safety/repression facts provide country-year baselines requiring narrative ruler attribution.
Political-freedom D11 country-year facts usable as structured priors.
D11 civil-liberties, expression, association, press/media, voice, accountability, and rule-of-law facts usable as structured priors for opposition/media/protest/civil-society tolerance.
D5 economic level/scale and BTI status facts provide country-year context; they do not by themselves establish distribution, causation, or ruler credit.
D6 HDI, health, education, and income facts provide welfare baselines; publication/source-year warnings and ruler attribution still apply.
D15 corruption, accountability, and rule-of-law facts provide institutional context and must not be converted into personal-integrity claims without evidence.
D16 governance-capacity facts provide inherited/state-capacity context, not proof that the ruler selected goals or implemented them effectively.
